articles.title: How to Register
articles.content:
1. Click 'Join EUNCCU' button
2. Fill in your personal information
3. Choose your user type (Student/Alumnus)
4. Upload a profile picture (optional)
5. Create a password
6. Accept terms and conditions
7. Click 'Create Account'

articles.title: Login Process
articles.content:
1. Click the 'Login' button
2. Enter your registered email
3. Enter your password
4. Click 'Sign In'

articles.title: Password Reset
articles.content:
1. Click 'Forgot Password'
2. Enter your email address
3. Check your email for reset link
4. Click the link and create new password

articles.title: Accessing Books
articles.content:
1. Log into your account
2. Click 'Pages' in navigation
3. Select 'E-Library'
4. Browse available books
5. Click on a book to read

articles.title: Publishing Books
articles.content:
For Members:
1. Log into member account
2. Go to E-Library
3. Click 'Upload Book'
4. Fill book details
5. Upload PDF file
6. Submit for review

articles.title: Rating and Reviews
articles.content:
1. Open a book
2. Scroll to reviews section
3. Rate book (1-5 stars)
4. Write your review
5. Submit review
